type Id<T> = T;
type Union<T> = T | string;
type Box<T> = { v: T };
type Cond<T> = T extends string ? T : never;
type Both<A, B> = A & B;
type Second<A, B> = B;
type Nested<T> = Id<Id<T>>;
type List<T> = T[];
type Indexed<T> = T[keyof T];
type Defaulted<T, U = T> = U;
type Mapped<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] };
function viaId<T extends Id<T>>() {}
function viaUnion<T extends Union<T>>() {}
function viaBox<T extends Box<T>>() {}
function viaCond<T extends Cond<T>>() {}
function viaBoth<T extends Both<T, {}>>() {}
function viaFirst<T extends Second<T, string>>() {}
function viaSecond<T extends Second<string, T>>() {}
function viaNested<T extends Nested<T>>() {}
function viaList<T extends List<T>>() {}
function viaMutual<T extends U, U extends Id<T>>() {}
function viaOther<T extends Id<U>, U extends string>() {}
function viaIndexed<T extends Indexed<T>>() {}
function viaDefault<T extends Defaulted<T>>() {}
function viaMapped<T extends Mapped<T>>() {}
function viaDistributive<T extends (T extends string ? number : boolean)>() {}
type Self<T extends Self<T>> = T;
console.log('ready');
